description: Full cross-reference profile for a class or method: callers, callees, inheritance chain, interface implementations, overrides, attributes. Requires xref_index.json.gz (generated from DYNAMICSXREFDB via GenerateCache --xref-conn). Falls back to vector-search when XRef not loaded.

categories.description: Categories to include: 'all' (default), or comma-separated subset: 'calls,inheritance,usage,interfaces,overrides,attributes'

depth.description: Depth of caller chain to trace upward (default: 2, max: 4)

methodKey.description: Object or method key. Format: 'ClassName.methodName' for methods, 'ClassName' for class-level queries.

name: find_callers
